about: Candidate pages for the Hall of Fame snubs' Pro Bowl path (Oct 31, 2026; Sam, 8:31 pm, OK'ing "Pro Bowls in more than half his seasons (at least 5), never elected, eligible": "if that's how you have to see it then ok" · "all of those are fine to add with my clay rule"). The snub searches only find pages that mention a finalist or semifinalist, so this path needs its own list. Made in Sam's Lab from our own honors data (Pro Bowls 1997 on) and nflverse seasons: players with 5+ Pro Bowls in more than half their seasons, last season 2020 or earlier, not in the Hall. Jason Witten, Marshal Yanda and Torry Holt also pass but were already snubs. The job tests each page's own infobox (its Pro Bowl count and team years), not these numbers, so a list entry only gets a player read. Each title is a Wikipedia page title.
gap: Careers that began before 1997 aren't covered: our honors data starts in 1997, so an older player gets in only if a snub search finds his page or he is added here by hand. Ruben Brown (1995-2007) is listed with 8 Pro Bowls in our data; his infobox gives his real 9.
